message:
Milestone 11: the Dividend Week Ahead — seven locales, data by code, prose without figures (#12)

* Milestone 11: the Dividend Week Ahead, end to end, in seven locales

quantic-agent --week-ahead --out DIR researches the week after today with
the agentic loop, builds the post's data from the recorded tool results
(checked with provenance.check_data), has the model write two prose
sections with no figures (JSON via Ollama's format, sent back while they
have any, three attempts), translates them into es, ca, fr, de, it and pt,
and checks each translation (figures, a length near the English). A
translation that fails is held (exit 6); the rest are written, one file per
locale, all carrying the same data block. Every file is read back before
it is written. The run is recorded first, posts included (migration 0005).

Public data only, by the author's choice: no amounts, raises or radar;
content.md lists what Quantic would need to add. Prompts and the locale
table are package data, read with importlib.resources; YAML through PyYAML,
every string double-quoted. Real runs, the prompt measured in three
versions, and the translations' lengths are in
docs/benchmarks/2026-10-08-week-ahead/. Decision 0013.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Lesson 11: seven files, one set of figures

The Week Ahead's story: what the public data can say, the ISO week, a
model that didn't know what day it was, data by code and prose by the
model, prose without figures measured, YAML's guessed types, package data,
and translations that pass every check while being wrong. Linked from the
lessons index, with its formatted page and code walkthrough.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
